findings.location: Article, paragraph beginning “Even nature shows us…”
findings.source_quote: “A caterpillar must give up its entire identity”
findings.suggested_fix: Change “अपना पूरा रूप छोड़कर” to “अपनी पूरी पहचान छोड़कर” to convey the source’s metaphor of giving up its entire identity.
findings.translation_quote: “एक इल्ली को अपना पूरा रूप छोड़कर”

findings.location: Article, paragraph beginning “So it is with you and me.”
findings.source_quote: “our Loving Father preparing our souls for heaven”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “हमारा प्रेमी पिता” with “हमसे प्रेम करने वाला पिता” to avoid the possible Hindi reading of “प्रेमी” as “lover.”
findings.translation_quote: “हमारा प्रेमी पिता हमारी आत्माओं को स्वर्ग के लिए तैयार कर रहा है”

findings.location: Article, paragraph beginning “Radically different then the lawless slogan…”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “अराजक नारे” with “नियमहीन नारे” to convey “lawless” more directly in this context.
